rows.grounds: concluding particle marking end of chapter
compound antaḥkaraṇa (inner organ) + paṭala (chapter/section), nominative singular masculine
ordinal adjective in nominative singular masculine

items.question: What chapter of the Kālottara treats the inner organ?
items.inference: The Kālottara's seventh chapter is the inner-organ chapter.
items.plain_english: Thus in the Kālottara, the seventh chapter is the chapter on the inner organ.
